sentences.en: The university facilities include a gym and a library.
sentences.zh: 大学设施包括健身房和图书馆。

sentences.en: She spends a lot of time in the university facilities studying.
sentences.zh: 她经常在大学设施里学习，花了很多时间。

sentences.en: The university facilities offer free internet access to students 24/7.
sentences.zh: 大学设施为学生提供全天候的免费上网服务。
